label: receipt_idle
title: Receipt service
body: New requests enter with auth-derived tenant and principal. The durable receipt, request bytes, routing owner and per-attempt object remain separate.

label: receipt_precheck
title: Checking the receipt
body: Authority and privacy controls precede write-path replay lookup. An early refusal stores nothing. A deterministic local rescrub changes stored source bytes, while raw request bytes keep their replay identity.

label: receipt_staged
title: Staged encrypted receipt
body: A short transaction pins the immutable active bundle and counts quota once per key. The encrypted object is written outside that transaction; Admission runs synchronously before final acceptance.

label: receipt_result
title: Receipt transaction result
body: A committed receipt and its Admission outcome survive a lost response or post-commit audit failure. Matching bytes replay under the original routing owner; mismatched bytes or ownership are refused.

label: receipt_orphans
title: Receipt attempt cleanup
body: Staged attempts and their objects can outlive failed requests. Cleanup can fail and retry; an attempt whose staging row expired or was swept cannot commit. Quota usage remains counted.
